metadata.title: The complex kinematics of the young stars orbiting the supermassive black hole in the Galactic center can be explained by the presence of an intermediate mass companion of Sgr A$^\star$

notes: No eligible stars: the paper discusses simulated young stellar populations and an intermediate-mass companion, and mentions hyper-velocity stars only as a generic population without individually identifiable members. No specific star is identified or followed up as a Galactic unbound candidate.
